name: FHA-14C-100 (FHA-C Mini)
encoder: dual absolute (15-bit motor input, 14-bit output), battery-less within one turn
notes: Compact hollow-shaft AC servo actuator: pancake BLDC motor plus zero-backlash Harmonic Drive strain-wave gear. FHA-C Mini family sizes 8C/11C/14C with ratios 30/50/100:1. For FHA-14C at 100:1 the maximum (peak/momentary) torque is 28 N·m and continuous/rated torque is about 6.8 N·m; maximum output speed 60 rpm. 'Zero backlash' is the manufacturer strain-wave claim (recorded as 0). Positioning accuracy about 90 arc-sec (1.5 arcmin); repeatability not published in accessible sources, so left null. 24VDC integrated-drive version communicates via CANopen (4-wire) with an EtherCAT option. Weight about 1.65 kg per Radwell distributor listing for the exact FHA-14C-100-D200-M1-SP part. Quote-only pricing.

name: SHA-CG series (SHA-CG Hollow Shaft Actuator)
encoder: magnetic dual absolute, output resolution up to ~20,971,520 pulse/rev
notes: Hollow-shaft AC servo actuator combining a CSG zero-backlash strain-wave gear with a brushless servomotor and integrated servo drive (EtherCAT/CANopen). Four frame sizes, five reduction ratios 50:1 to 160:1. The series delivers up to 3,400 N·m across sizes; positional accuracy better than 1 arcmin and repeatability better than +/-5 arc-sec (recorded as ~0.08 arcmin). This is a multi-size series, so per-size rated/peak torque, weight and speed are not a single value and are left null rather than guessed. 'Zero backlash' recorded as 0 per the manufacturer strain-wave claim. Quote-only pricing.

name: CHA series (Hollow Shaft Servo Actuator)
notes: CHA hollow-shaft servo actuator: synchronous servomotor plus CPU-H series zero-backlash strain-wave gear plus a high-capacity precision output bearing. Available in eight sizes, gear ratios 30:1 to 160:1, with maximum torque from about 9 N·m up to 1,840 N·m across the size range (per Harmonic Drive SE product page). Requires a matching external servo drive (CANopen/EtherCAT drives offered). This is a multi-size series, so per-size rated/peak torque, weight, speed and repeatability are left null rather than guessed. Backlash recorded as 0 per the strain-wave zero-backlash claim. Quote-only pricing.

name: LPA-20 (Low Profile Rotary Actuator)
notes: Low-profile integrated servo actuator aimed at humanoid/cobot joints and surgical robotics. Combines zero-backlash Harmonic Drive gearing, a brushless servomotor, brake, dual absolute encoders and an integrated servo drive (CANopen/EtherCAT). Gear ratios 51/81/101:1. Continuous torque 6.5 to 16.9 N·m and maximum (peak) torque 34 to 57 N·m depending on ratio; recorded values are the top-of-range (101:1) figures. Weight about 1.4 kg. Rated supply voltage 48 VDC (confirmed via distributor listing). torque_density computed from peak 57 N·m over 1.4 kg. Repeatability not published in accessible sources, so left null. Quote-only pricing.

name: LHS series (Harmonic Drive strain-wave reducer)
notes: Strain-wave (harmonic) gear reducer component, a Harmonic Drive alternative used to build precision robot-arm joints, not a motorized actuator, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. Sizes about 14/17/20/25/32/40/50 with reduction ratios 50/80/100/120/160:1. Rated output torque spans roughly 3.8 N·m (smallest size) up to about 921 N·m (largest size) with allowable peak torque above 4,000 N·m on large sizes, per distributor listings; specific per-size/ratio values are not confirmed from a primary Leaderdrive datasheet, so left null. Marketed as zero-backlash (recorded 0); transmission accuracy / lost motion typically about 10 arc-sec but not confirmed here. Quote-only pricing.

name: LHD series (hollow-shaft harmonic reducer)
notes: Compact hollow-shaft strain-wave (harmonic) gear reducer component for robot-arm joints; no integrated motor, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. Seven sizes (14/17/20/25/32/40 and larger) with reduction ratios 50/80/100/120/160:1; directindustry lists a coaxial hollow-shaft variant in the roughly 100 to 200 N·m class. Per-size rated/peak torque and weight are not confirmed from a primary Leaderdrive datasheet, so left null. Marketed zero-backlash (recorded 0). Quote-only pricing.

name: LCS series (cup-type harmonic reducer)

name: FLEXWAVE WPG series (strain-wave gearhead)
notes: FLEXWAVE strain-wave (harmonic) gearing from Nidec Drive Technology (formerly Nidec-Shimpo). This is a zero-backlash gear unit / gearhead component (flexspline, circular spline, wave generator), not a motorized actuator, so motor/electrical/comms fields are null. FLEXWAVE WPG spans five frame sizes (about 35 to 80 mm) with ratios from 50:1 up to 160:1 and maximum torque up to about 346 N·m across the range. Marketed zero-backlash with high repeatability. backdrivable set to false: high-ratio (50:1 to 160:1) strain-wave gearing is effectively non-backdrivable, consistent with the other harmonic units in this file. Per-size rated torque and repeatability-in-arc-sec are not confirmed from a primary datasheet here, so left null. Quote-only pricing.

name: Smart-FLEXWAVE SRH series (smart strain-wave reducer)
notes: Smart-FLEXWAVE (SRH / WPU-SRH-BD) is Nidec Drive Technology's ultra-thin, lightweight zero-backlash strain-wave 'smart reducer' with a built-in sensor that detects output torque and internal temperature, aimed at humanoid and cobot joints. The BD safety variant carries TUV SUD functional-safety certification. It is a reducer-with-sensor module (no integrated motor or drive), so torque/electrical/comms fields are left null pending a primary datasheet with per-size numbers. backdrivable set to false, consistent with high-ratio strain-wave gearing. Zero-backlash recorded as 0. Quote-only pricing.
